q: Sulphur is the non-metallic solid element with the symbol S and atomic number 16.
e: True. Sulphur is the non-metallic solid element with the symbol S and atomic number 16. Graphite is the unusual non-metallic solid that still conducts electricity.

e: True. In the Frasch Process, superheated steam at about 160°C is forced down under pressure through the outermost pipe to melt the sulphur. Gas pressure is the force of collisions on a unit area of the wall.

q: The oxidation number of sulphur in hydrogen sulphide ($H_2S$) is -2.
e: True. The oxidation number of sulphur in hydrogen sulphide (H_2S) is -2. For a simple ion the oxidation number equals the charge on the ion. Oxidation number is the charge an atom would have if electrons in each bond were assigned to the more electronegative atom.
